title: Call for Papers and Abstracts
summary: IEEE SSCI 2027 will invite full papers, short papers, late-breaking work, abstracts, and journal-to-conference submissions.

sections.heading: Submission Scope
paragraphs: Following recent IEEE SSCI practice, the program is expected to call for full papers, short papers, late-breaking papers, abstract-only submissions, and journal-to-conference conversions across the conference symposia.

sections.heading: Review Process
paragraphs: The review process is planned to use a centralized conference management system such as CMT3 or EasyChair. Full papers will follow a rigorous double-blind peer-review process with common review guidelines, standardized evaluation criteria, and coordinated acceptance thresholds across symposia.

title: Submission Instructions
summary: Submission instructions will be added once the submission system and policies are confirmed.

sections.heading: Planned Submission System
paragraphs: IEEE SSCI 2027 plans to use a centralized paper management system such as CMT3 or EasyChair. The final submission link, formatting requirements, page limits, and policy details will be published after confirmation.

title: Presentation Format
summary: Planned presentation formats for IEEE SSCI 2027.

sections.heading: Session Formats
bullets: Oral presentations: typically 20 minutes for the talk plus 5 minutes for Q&A.
Poster sessions: full paper posters, short paper posters, and late-breaking work or abstract posters.
Panels and interactive sessions: 60-90 minute moderated discussions with academic, industry, and government speakers.
Tutorials and workshops: half-day or full-day sessions, ideally scheduled before the main conference.
Competitions and challenge tracks: live presentations of results and winner announcements.

title: Venue Information
summary: IEEE SSCI 2027 is proposed for the Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre.

sections.heading: Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre
paragraphs: The proposed venue is the Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre (GCCEC), one of Australia's premier conference centres. It is centrally located in Broadbeach and is close to hotels, restaurants, the beach, and public transportation.

sections.heading: Capacity and Meeting Spaces
bullets: Over 10,000 square metres of configurable event space
Main arena seating up to 6,000 participants
18 meeting rooms and boardrooms for parallel sessions, workshops, and panels
Small rooms for 20-50 seats and mid-size rooms for 100-300 seats
Foyers and exhibition areas for registration, posters, networking, and social functions

sections.heading: Technology, Accessibility, and Amenities
bullets: High-speed Wi-Fi throughout the venue
AV-equipped rooms supporting live streaming, virtual presentations, and hybrid meetings
On-site technical support
Wheelchair accessibility, accessible restrooms, elevators, and designated parking
Catering, exhibitor support, business centre, lounges, and Green Globe certified operations

title: Travel Information
summary: Travel information for Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia.

sections.heading: Airports
bullets: Brisbane Airport (BNE) is approximately 85 km from the Gold Coast and offers direct connections to major Asian and North American hubs, with one-stop connections to Europe via Doha, Dubai, Singapore, and other hubs.
Gold Coast Airport (OOL) is approximately 30 minutes from the proposed venue and offers regional and selected international connections, including New Zealand and Southeast Asia.

sections.heading: Local Transport
bullets: The region is served by the G:link light rail, buses, shuttles, taxis, and rideshare services.
The Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre is located next to Broadbeach North tram station.
Recommended hotels are within walking distance of the venue.

sections.heading: Visa Guidance
paragraphs: Australia offers online visa pathways for many international visitors. The conference will provide visa support letters upon request for registered authors, presenters, and attendees.
bullets: eVisitor visa (Subclass 651) for citizens of the EU, UK, and several other European countries
Electronic Travel Authority (ETA, Subclass 601) for passport holders from the USA, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, and others
Visitor visa (Subclass 600) for other countries; attendees are encouraged to apply well in advance
